div.div: Session structure and series position
Aliasing -> Mutability: shared names expose in-place changes (inferred)
Mutability -> Cloning: copies can prevent unintended shared changes (inferred)
Cloning -> Deep vs shallow copies: copy depth decides whether nested objects are shared (inferred)
Nested lists -> Deep vs shallow copies: nested objects are the case where depth matters (inferred)
